_comment: Naar seller KYC map — confirm a seller on a marketplace even under a DIFFERENT store/brand name, and skip marketplaces they're not on. Naar already holds gstin + legal entity from seller onboarding/KYC, so this is a DB export, not manual lookup. Copy to seller_identity.json (gitignored) or point NAAR_KYC_FILE at your export. Keyed by Naar sellerId. All fields optional; strongest signal wins (GTIN/GSTIN > store URL > legal name). 'not_on' lets the pipeline skip marketplaces a seller isn't on (no wasted fetch).
